weight_grid_finding: Chronologically selected 3-year weights provide negligible whole-player gain. They do not justify replacing 60/30/10 as a general default.
shrinkage_finding: Opportunity-conditioned shrinkage is materially more useful than weight retuning and aligns with the residual evidence that high prior opportunity is over-persistent while low prior opportunity is under-projected.

selected_2025_pattern.RB: opportunity-conditioned shrinkage selected for carries, rushing yards/TD, targets, receptions, receiving yards/TD (20-40% shrink)
selected_2025_pattern.WR: opportunity-conditioned shrinkage selected for all receiving targets and most rushing production except carries (10-40%)
selected_2025_pattern.TE: opportunity-conditioned shrinkage selected for targets/receptions/receiving yards/TD (10-30%); rare rushing stats remain baseline
selected_2025_pattern.QB: mostly baseline; shrinkage only on interceptions/sacks/rushing components

interpretation: Historical weighting is not the main edge. Role/opportunity regression-to-mean is a real signal, but its standalone gains are smaller and less stable than the best age/opportunity Ridge ensembles.
